shots.say: How can Milo get warm in the snow? He is so cold, he cannot stop shivering!
The Animated Zoo!
Hello, I'm Milo! I came to visit my friend Poppy the polar bear cub, in the snowy Arctic.
Hi, Milo! Welcome to the Arctic! Do you want to play in the snow with me?
Yes, please! But I am so cold. My little scarf is too tiny!
Who is cold? Milo, or Poppy?
I am not cold at all! I feel cozy and warm.
I want to get warm, so I can play in the snow with Poppy!
shots.tag: Milo: I want to get warm

shots.say: Milo has a big leaf from home. He wraps it around him, like a blanket.
But the leaf is too thin! The cold wind blows right through it.
That leaf is so thin, Milo. I can almost see you through it! Hee hee!
Is a thin leaf a warm blanket? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: leaf warm yes or no

shots.say: I know! I can hop to warm up. Can you hop with me? One hop, two hops, three hops!
Milo hops and hops, all over the snow. Then he stops. He is so tired! He needs a rest.
Can Milo hop all day long? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: hop all day yes or no

shots.say: Maybe the sunshine can warm me up! Milo flies to a sunny spot on the ice.
But the sun sits very low in the sky. It looks pale, not hot. Then a cloud floats right in front of it.
shots.tag: the low pale sun, a cloud

shots.say: Come back, sunshine! Oh, I am still so cold.
Is the sun high in the sky today, or low?
Milo sits down in the snow, and looks at the far, white ice. He feels a little sad.
Maybe the Arctic is too cold, for a little bird like me.
Poppy walks over, and sits right beside him. Don't worry, Milo. I will help you.
Can a good friend help Milo feel better? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: friend helps yes or no

shots.say: Poppy, how do you stay so warm?
Let me show you what is under my fluffy coat!
Polar bears have two layers of fur. A soft, thick layer close to the skin, and long hairs on top.
How many layers of fur does a polar bear have? Two, or ten?
And under the skin, a thick layer of fat keeps polar bears warm, even when they swim in cold water.
shots.tag: fact: thick fat keeps them warm

shots.say: What keeps a polar bear warm? A thick layer of fat, or ice cream?
Can you give yourself a big, warm hug, like a cozy fur coat? Hug, hug!
I am a little bird. I do not have a fur coat like you.
But I have an idea! A cozy nest, out of the wind, right next to my fluffy friend!
A snow nest! Let's build it together!
Poppy pushes the soft snow into a round wall, with her big paws. Milo pats it smooth with his wings.
Let's count the snow blocks! One, two, three!
Milo snuggles into the nest. The snow wall stops the wind. And Poppy curls up, right beside him.
shots.tag: Milo snuggles in, Poppy curls up

shots.say: Oh! Now I feel warm and cozy!
Is Milo cold now, or warm?
Fluffy fur and a cozy nest. Warm with friends, that's the best!
Now we can play in the snow together!
Poppy makes big paw prints in the snow, and Milo makes tiny bird prints, right beside them.
Look, Poppy! Big prints and tiny prints, side by side. Just like us!
The sun goes down, and the sky turns pink. Milo and Poppy snuggle up in the cozy nest.
Thank you, Poppy! You helped me get warm.
And you found a cozy idea, Milo! Good friends help each other.
When you feel cold, find a cozy spot, and snuggle up close with someone who loves you.
Do you remember? How many layers of fur does a polar bear have? Two, or one?
And what is under a polar bear's skin? A thick layer of fat, or feathers?
Fluffy fur and a cozy nest. Warm with friends, that's the best!
Next time: Poppy and the Dancing Sky! See you on the next adventure, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
